text:
samir: @oncall seeing a spike of 5xx + request timeouts hitting hosted inference in us-west-2 starting ~08:03 UTC. Multiple customer escalations in support queue. Can infra take a look?

ops-bot: ALERT: hosted-inference-us-west-2 - 5xx-rate 18% -> threshold breached. PD incident created: INC-1768804321. Paging oncall.

jordan: I'm seeing a repeated pattern in gateway logs: auth proxy upstream calls to kms are getting 504/timeout and then gateway returns 502. sample log: 
```
2026-03-17T08:04:12Z gateway us-west-2 proxy: upstream=auth-proxy-1 status=504 latency=2003ms err="kms: timeout (throttle)"
2026-03-17T08:04:12Z gateway us-west-2 inference: model-serve-3 status=502
```

maria: KMS API error rate jumped +120% at 08:02 UTC in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Could be quota/throttle or a bad key rotation. I'm checking KMS metrics & recent deploys to key-management.

alexa: Noted customer reports: high latency + some 5xx when requests include signed billing tokens. Could be auth token refresh path hitting KMS for verification. If KMS falters, gateway backpressure cascades -> runtime OOM/timeouts.

ryan: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) apply fallback-route to route incoming traffic to model-variant with local auth cache enabled, 2) temporarily disable the recent auth-proxy change rolled out last night (revert commit a1b2c3), 3) increase auth-proxy connection pool and small timeout bump to avoid client timeouts. Recommend #1+2 asap.

jordan: Repro snippet from curl hitting endpoint (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=xlarge-hosted
```
Response: intermittent 502 + long TTFB. Tracing shows auth-proxy calls to KMS for token validation (sync) on every request for these token types.

maria: Confirmed: a key rotation job at 07:59 UTC started renewing customer keys in us-west-2 and triggered heavier-than-expected KMS calls. KMS started returning 429/504 on retries. We're opening a ticket with KMS provider and temporarily scaling retry backoff to reduce pressure.

samir: Actionable mitigation we can do now: ryan apply fallback-route policy (route to variant with auth-cache) -> alexa notify support to tell affected customers short ETA -> jordan/ops monitor error rate & KV cache hit rate. I'll create postmortem draft and doc.

ryan: I'm toggling the fallback-route now (rolling config change). Patch id cfg-2026-03-17-01. Setting model fallback to "xlarge-hosted-authcached" for 20% of traffic then ramp if stable.

ops-bot: CHANGE: cfg-2026-03-17-01 applied in us-west-2 to 20% of traffic. Rollout initiated.

support-bot: Affected customers (high priority): cid-445, cid-998, cid-1202. Support tickets: #5482, #5483, #5489. Sending scripted customer update: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx/timeouts; applying mitigations now; will follow up with timeline." :white_check_mark:

jordan: After rollout to 20% we saw 5xx rate drop from 18% -> 9% within 2 minutes for routed traffic. Full rollout to 100% in progress pending smoke checks.

maria: KMS provider reports increased internal retries causing visible latency to their API calls. They are throttling some regions. They've opened a support window and will increase capacity; expected stabilization in ~30-45 minutes.

ryan: Full fallback rollout to 100% complete at 08:10 UTC. Observability: 5xx rate dropped to 2.4%, customer impact decreasing.

samir: Good. Logging immediate action items: 
- ryan: keep fallback route & plan next sustainable config (owner ryan, ETA 2h)
- jordan: collect full traces for 08:00-08:15 window and attach to incident doc (owner jordan, ETA 1h)
- maria: KMS provider contact + post-incident vendor report (owner maria, ETA EOD)
- alexa: customer comms and prioritization for the three P1s (owner alexa, ETA 30m)
- samir: draft postmortem + schedule incident review (owner samir, ETA 3h)

alexa: Customer comms sent to P1s and posted status page update. Will prepare follow-up e-mail with root-cause summary once we have traces. :eyes:

support-bot: Tickets updated with mitigation note and ETA. Setting SLA pause for P1 until resolved.

ops-bot: METRICS: gateway.5xx_rate(us-west-2) 08:02=18% 08:10=2.4% 08:20=0.9%. Traces collected for window.

samir: Postmortem plan: immediate incident writeup in confluence -> include timeline, root cause hypothesis (KMS overload + sync token validation), remediation (auth cache, key rotation safety checks), and near-term safeguards (circuit breakers, async token validation, rate-limited KMS callers). Schedule 90m RCA meeting at 13:00 PST.

jordan: Quick note: we should add a synthetic test that exercises token validation path at scale during deploys to catch regressions in key rotation scripts.

maria: Also propose an emergency guard: if KMS error rate > X% then flip auth-proxy to cached-validation mode automatically. I'll draft the detection rule.

samir: OK. I'll own the postmortem doc skeleton and add action owners. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incident/INC-1768804321 (placeholder). Please update assigned items once you start work.

ryan: Closing loop: observed customer complaints reduced to near-zero. I'll keep the fallback route in place until we have vendor confirmation and we've deployed a safer key rotation job.

alexa: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene at the RCA. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: INCIDENT: INC-1768804321 status=stabilized severity=high participants=7
